purpose: A small owner-requested extension: short written sequences and word copying, with early writing-system foundations. This is not full language understanding.
source_note: Selected original Unicode letter records inspected on 2026-09-04. Character identities, not pronunciations or meanings. Preserve exact code points; no transliteration or silent normalization.

lanes.scope: Eight independent vowel characters, then combinations. Not the complete script, Hindi vocabulary, pronunciation, or comprehension.
Eight base letter code points, then combinations in logical order. Rendering/joining is separate; not the complete script, Arabic vocabulary, or comprehension.
Seven additional written forms, including accented vowels, n with tilde, and u with diaeresis. Not seven new alphabet letters or Spanish comprehension.

prerequisites: Full familiar Latin-letter reproduction is measured before the bridge. Start each new lane with four characters; expand after 90% familiar reproduction, retaining earlier correct characters. Native word meanings and grammar remain locked pending reviewed original-language primers and their own tests.
mixed_quizzes: Each visible main quiz has unused prompts, balanced across exact copying, joining separated symbols, and selecting first/last symbols. Length starts at three and rises to at most six only after every task reaches 90%. Taught script subsets may mix with Latin. Mistakes become labeled familiar feedback, never fresh again. Fixed reserved sequences are excluded across all operation families; retention is a brief separate summary.
assessment: Reserve fixed three-/four-letter banks never selected for automatic teaching; report repeated held-out scores honestly. The old exhausted two-letter pool is not reset or relabeled unseen. Require 90% on both reserved banks and separate fresh checks before certifying the English sequence stage.
resource_policy: One learner, unchanged parameters and graph; serial language lanes, batches at most four, existing CPU-thread/time/disk budgets and owner stop controls.
